value.name: 60' · Andréas Hountondji v Hamburger SV
value.narrative: Joel Chima Fujita: splits the Hamburg defence with a through ball. Andréas Hountondji: runs clear, rounds the keeper and scores from a tight angle.

sequence.note: Threads a pass behind the Hamburg back line to free Hountondji.
Goes through alone and takes the ball around Heuer Fernandes.
Slots into the empty net from an acute angle.
